themes.description: The song centers on remembering a past relationship and the ache of its absence.
Nighttime serves as both setting and emotional mirror for the protagonist's inner state.
A nocturne (夜曲) becomes the vessel for preserving what the relationship meant.

narrative_potential.reasoning: The lyrics trace a clear emotional journey with a protagonist, specific settings (night streets, rain), and a turning point in the bridge. Strong support for a story-driven MV with intercut performance.

visual_metaphors.visual_translation: Rain falling on the protagonist, water reflections distorting city lights, wet surfaces mirroring emotional turbulence
Close-up of fingers on piano keys dissolving into flashback sequences, musical notes becoming visual particles
Gradual color shift from cool blue night to warm golden dawn, the protagonist silhouetted against morning sky

color_mood_suggestions.lighting: Warm interior light, golden hour memory

performance_cues.description: Subtle sadness, distant gaze, slight furrowed brow
Tension building in posture, hands clenching, forward lean
Full emotional release, expansive gestures, head tilted back during high notes
Near-motionless delivery, eyes closed, single tear track
Slow release, hands opening, walking forward with calm resolve

sections.section_visual_summary: A solitary urban nightscape drenched in rain, illuminated only by distant neon and streetlights. The mood is set through environment alone before any character appears.

sections.lyrics_text: 一群嗜血的蚂蚁被腐肉所吸引...

key_lines.text: 一群嗜血的蚂蚁被腐肉所吸引
key_lines.visual_potential: Dark imagery, decaying beauty, macro close-up transitioning to urban decay
key_lines.performance_note: Deliver with controlled intensity, minimal movement

key_lines.text: 我听见你的声音有种特别的感觉
key_lines.visual_potential: Sound visualization, protagonist stopping mid-step as if hearing something
key_lines.performance_note: Sudden shift from walking to stillness

sections.section_visual_summary: The protagonist walks through night streets that once held shared memories. Each familiar location is now tinged with absence. Close-up shots emphasize internal emotion while the environment tells the external story.

key_lines.visual_potential: Literal shadow of a second person that the protagonist reaches for but cannot touch
key_lines.performance_note: Peak emotional intensity, full vocal power with matching physical expression

sections.section_visual_summary: Full visual crescendo: the emotional core of the MV. Wide cinematic compositions mixed with tight emotional close-ups. The memory and present timelines collide visually through cross-dissolves and parallel editing.

analysis_notes: The lyrics strongly support a narrative MV with a clear emotional arc. The night/rain motif provides a consistent visual anchor. The bridge section offers a natural turning point for visual transformation from cool to warm tones.
